type Raw string
type UserReplaceOutcome uint32
const UserReplaceOutcomeApplied
const UserReplaceOutcomeConflict
const UserReplaceOutcomeForbidden
const UserReplaceOutcomeUnavailable
func (UserReplaceOutcome) String() string
func (UserReplaceOutcome) WireName() (string, bool)
func ParseUserReplaceOutcome(word string) (UserReplaceOutcome, bool)
func (UserReplaceOutcome) MarshalText() ([]byte, error)
func (UserReplaceOutcome) UnmarshalText(text []byte) error
func (UserReplaceOutcome) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
func (UserReplaceOutcome) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error
func UserReplaceOutcomeValues() []UserReplaceOutcome
func (UserReplaceOutcome) Known() bool

const ServiceErrorCodeInvalidResult

const ServiceErrorCodeWrongMode

var ReaderErrorCodes
var EditorErrorCodes
type RunOverrides struct
  NasStore string
  Store string
  LogSink string
  LogService string
type Origin struct
  Rung string
  Path string
type Origins struct
  NasStore Origin
  Store Origin
  LogSink Origin
  LogService Origin
  Off Origin
type Snapshot struct
  NasStore string
  Store string
  LogSink string
  LogService string
  Off map[string]string
  Origins Origins
  Stamp string
type UserSettings struct
  NasStore string
  Store string
  LogSink string
  LogService string
  Off map[string]string
type UserSnapshot struct
  Values UserSettings
  Revision string
type UserReplaceResult struct
  Outcome UserReplaceOutcome
  Snapshot UserSnapshot
type ConfigObservation struct
  Outcome ConfigObservationOutcome
  Cursor string
  Snapshot *Snapshot
func Encode(v *Snapshot) []byte
type Refusal struct
  Word string
  Offset int
func (Refusal) Error() string
func Decode(in []byte) (*Snapshot, error)
type FrameWriter interface
  WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
type DispatchError string
func (DispatchError) Error() string
func ServiceName(frame []byte) (string, error)
type FrameExchanger interface
  ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ServiceError struct
  Code ServiceErrorCode
  Message string
func (ServiceError) Error() string
const EndpointContract
type DescribedService interface
  DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func DescribeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...DescribedService) ([]byte, error)
type ServedService interface
  DescribedService
  ServiceContract() string
func ServeEndpoint(frame []byte, program, version string, services ...ServedService) ([]byte, error)
type ConfigReader interface
  Read(overrides RunOverrides) (Snapshot, error)
type ConfigReaderTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type ConfigReaderClient struct
func NewConfigReaderClient(t ConfigReaderTransport) *ConfigReaderClient
type ConfigReaderDispatcher struct
  Handler ConfigReader
func (ConfigReaderClient) Read(overrides RunOverrides) (result Snapshot, err error)
func (ConfigReaderDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (ConfigReaderDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (ConfigReaderDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (ConfigReaderDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type ConfigEditor interface
  ReadUser() (UserSnapshot, error)
  ReplaceUser(expectedRevision string, values UserSettings) (UserReplaceResult, error)
type ConfigEditorTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type ConfigEditorClient struct
func NewConfigEditorClient(t ConfigEditorTransport) *ConfigEditorClient
type ConfigEditorDispatcher struct
  Handler ConfigEditor
func (ConfigEditorClient) ReadUser() (result UserSnapshot, err error)
func (ConfigEditorClient) ReplaceUser(expectedRevision string, values UserSettings) (result UserReplaceResult, err error)
func (ConfigEditorDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (ConfigEditorDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (ConfigEditorDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (ConfigEditorDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)

  Observe(overrides RunOverrides, cursor string, waitMs int64) (ConfigObservation, error)
